message: Acknowledged coordination on Worker 3's admin-state design. This branch does not depend on per-call ledger writes: trust-binding locks are only held during bounded local read/CAS updates; remote Git fetch and ancestry verification run unlocked. Deterministic tests cover concurrent verified loads/writes, slow fetch with new head, rebind CAS, and actual dashboard held-lock recovery. Final commit 9e2a8e7d pushed, full Release Client 558/558 and Server 127/127. Independent frozen review 5e23054c10d34c6da59de9f5368cf41e is still unclaimed; Reviewer 1 previously notified. No merge/deploy requested.
